info.name: AssetShield GH · API
info.description: Frontend reference collection for AssetShield GH. Base URL points at the gateway; collection-level auth sends Bearer {{accessToken}} (public endpoints override to none). Run Auth → Login (or Register → Verify OTP) first to capture tokens, then click through Properties → Damage → Marketplace → Notifications. See FRONTEND_HANDOFF.md.

request.description: Public. Starts registration and sends an OTP. Errors: PHONE_EXISTS(409), VALIDATION(400).
Public. Creates an AGENT (starts PENDING verification). Errors: PHONE_EXISTS(409).
Public. Dev OTP is OTP_DEV_CODE (123456). Returns tokens. Errors: OTP_INVALID(400), OTP_EXPIRED(400).
Public. Returns access(1h)+refresh(14d). Wrong creds → 401 (identical body for unknown phone).
Public. Rotates the refresh token. Reuse of a rotated token → 401 REFRESH_REUSED (whole family revoked).
User. multipart image/jpeg|png. Used for KYC.
User. Act-843 erasure request (soft-delete + purge schedule).
Owner. type ∈ RESIDENTIAL|COMMERCIAL|RENTAL. FREE tier: max 1 property → FREE_TIER_LIMIT(403).
Owner. Makes the property a marketplace lead.
Owner/export-member. multipart file + metadata JSON. sha256 MUST match the bytes → else 400 HASH_MISMATCH. Duplicate hash → 409 DUPLICATE_ASSET_HASH. See FRONTEND_HANDOFF photo recipe.
Public, token-gated download (local storage provider). Signed URLs expire ~15 min.
Owner/export-member. disasterType ∈ FIRE|FLOOD|THEFT|STORM|OTHER. occurredAt not in future.
Owner/export-member. Returns GPS pairing suggestions. sha256 verified → 400 HASH_MISMATCH.
Owner/export-member. pairingMethod ∈ GPS_AUTO|MANUAL. Freezes the asset snapshot.
Owner/export-member. Freezes everything + computes total loss. IMMUTABLE afterwards.
Owner. Starts the fee checkout. PENDING_PAYMENT→GENERATING→READY. mock auto-settles ~2s.
Owner. READY only (402 before payment). Signed URL expires ~15 min.
Public. READY dossiers only. 404 after the owner rotates the token.
Owner. Kills any leaked public link.
Agent (verified). Starts the agent subscription checkout. mock auto-settles → ACTIVE.
Agent (verified+subscribed). 404 unless the property is opted in (no existence leak).
Owner. Accepting opens the consent channel.
Owner. Cascade-revokes shares; agent API access sealed immediately.
Owner. Consent-gated share of a READY dossier to an accepted agent.
Agent (shared). Recomputes the manifest hash to prove tamper-evidence.
Payer. Call after returning from the Paystack checkout.
Public. HMAC-SHA512 over raw bytes via x-paystack-signature. Bad/no signature → 401.
User. Call on login and on FCM token refresh. platform ∈ ANDROID|IOS.
